segments.name: Community Banking
segments.description: Provides deposit, lending, wealth management, and mortgage products and services to consumers, businesses, and municipal entities in Illinois and eastern Iowa.
segments.evidence: Through our bank subsidiary, Heartland Bank and Trust Company ("Heartland Bank" or the "Bank"), we provide a comprehensive suite of financial products and services to consumers, businesses, and municipal entities throughout Illinois and eastern Iowa.

revenueModel.text: The company earns interest income from loans and investments plus noninterest income from deposit customer activity, wealth management activities, and mortgage servicing.
revenueModel.evidence: Interest income from loans and investments as well as noninterest income from deposit customer activity, wealth management activities, and mortgage servicing generate the significant revenues.

changes.text: In 2023, HBT Financial completed its acquisition of Town and Country Financial Corporation, whose bank branches began operating as branches of Heartland Bank.
changes.evidence: On February 1, 2023, HBT Financial completed its acquisition of Town and Country Financial Corporation ("Town and Country"), the holding company for Town and Country Bank.
